message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2026), 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP. Using that approximation:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So, roughly, $20 is about £15.60 at the time of writing. For an exact, up‑to‑minute conversion you’d want to check a live currency converter or your bank’s exchange rate.
